question: Which of the following countries is NOT a Permanent Member of the Security Council?
solution:
The correct answer is **Canada**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **United Nations Security Council (UNSC)** has **five permanent members**.
 
• The **Permanent Members** are: **France**, **China**, **Russia**, the **United Kingdom**, and the **United States**.
 
• **Canada** is not a **Permanent Member** of the **UNSC**.
